arxiv-2510-03761.description: Abstract The widespread use of preprint repositories such as arXiv has accelerated the communication of scientific results but also introduced overlooked security risks. Male Sprague Dawley rats were administered Echinacea (250 mg/kg) or vehicle once daily for 10 days, followed by a single oral dose of favipiravir (70 mg/kg) or atazanavir (35 mg/kg).
